english: But... I'm too tired\nto bother, man...
Never said much to begin with...\nBeing listless doesn't really\nchange the impression.
Not moving a muscle...\nIt's a little... no,\nREALLY creepy...
Yes! That's it!\nI was looking for\nthat curly-haired guy!
Don't call me Kappa!\nIt's Mr. Ebina!
Kagura, let's go.\nThis is a pain.
Oh, you again.\nI'm too busy to chat.
Ikumatsu...?\nWhat a relief.\nBack to her old self.
Oh, Hamuko.\nYou seem back to normal.
The [blue]TV station[/color]\nshould be back to normal\ntoo. What a relief...
The [blue]Oedo Hospital[/color]\nhead nurse! You're\nback to normal! Thank goodness!
Looking for Zura, huh?\nGlad we could help.
I saw Zura near\n[blue]Oedo Mart[/color].\fTold you that\nlast time too, right?
Zura was near [blue]Oedo Mart[/color].\nWhy not try there?
What were you doing here?\n...Looking for Katsura?
But surely he's\nleft that place by now...
If not, leave me alone.\nAnswering you\nis too much work.
Even standing here\nis exhausting...\nMoving's even worse.
At night, my feet\ntake me into town.\nWhat a pain...
What? Got a problem?!\n...Forget it.\nPicking fights is a pain.
You again...\nWant these nails and plane?\nCheap. No, take them free.
Get a grip!\nWhere's your usual spirit?
With firefighters like this,\na fire would be a disaster.
Still wandering around?\nTake it easy for once.
All that work,\nand you can't even eat them.\nI'm sick of it.
A favor...\nCarry me on your back\nacross the Sanzu River?
What...? I said\nI'm not opening up...
Need something?\nIf not, leave me alone.\nI'm so tired...
Oh, you lot...\nWhy are you wandering?
No business? Leave me\nalone... no rules in the jungle.
Too lazy to be lazy.\nSo I stopped thinking.\nBrilliant, eh?
Let them swell.\nBigger portions.\nCustomers'll love it.
What's up?\nCome for swollen noodles\nand bigger portions?
Too much trouble to go HOME...?!
Too lazy to play? You're a KID!
But playing's too much trouble too... What to do...
I've seen you somewhere...\nDon't care who you are...
You again...?\nTalking's too much work.\nLeave me alone...
You again...?\nWhat? Selling land?\fToo much work.\nTry someone else...
You again?\nLeave me alone. Too much work.
You again? Leave me alone.\nToo much work.\nSick of men's faces.
The director and cameraman\ncan't be bothered either...\nNo more broadcasts today.
YOU still haven't gone\nback to the hospital?!
Still wandering around?\nSo much time and energy...
Leave me alone.\nI'm doing my own thing...
But I won't give up Jump.\nNothing else matters, though...
Need something? I'm busy.\nSpit it out, then.

Crap! I forgot!
I've got something to do!
Can't hang around here! You guys do your best, too.
Laze around and the game's
gonna end before you know it!
Let it go.\nBest to forget a bad dream.
